paper_citation: Igata H, Ikegaya Y, Sasaki T (2021). Prioritized experience replays on a hippocampal predictive map for learning. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 118, e2011266118. https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2011266118
apparatus: 1 m square open field in a 5 x 5 lattice of 20 cm squares, with a start area, a goal area and an L-shaped return path, on a 1.4 x 1.2 m platform

archive.name: Mendeley Data 4xk5w69yr5 (version 2)
archive.citation: Igata H, Ikegaya Y, Sasaki T (2020). Prioritized experience replays on a hippocampal predictive map for learning (Version 2) [Data set]. Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/4xk5w69yr5.2

sampling_rate.source: the median frame rate of the files, which the check reads: 24.70 to 24.88 Hz on every session. The SI Appendix of Igata et al. 2021 states 24.5 Hz, and the mean frame interval gives that, 24.49 to 24.50 Hz on every session; frames arrive 36 to 47 ms apart, unevenly enough that the median sits 1.2% above the mean

position_span.source: the SI Appendix of Igata et al. 2021: 'The overall size of the platform ... was 1.2 m x 1.4 m'; the largest span of the tracked positions must lie within 20% of 140 cm

speed_limit.source: Iriarte-Díaz 2002, J. Exp. Biol. 205:2897-2908, Table 1: Rattus runs at most 13.78 body lengths/s at a 0.190 m body length, 2.62 m/s (from Garland 1983 and Nowak 1999); times 1.5 because the tracked point is an LED cluster on the head, which swings faster than the body, and no source read states head speed

sessions.verification: Checked by hand on 2026-11-05 against the archive, the readme, virtual_maze_field.py, the paper and its SI: the Learning_data zip's rat1 folder; 114 units, the SI's count for rat 1, on 13 tetrodes, the SI's Fig. S6; the file stitched from 63 trial and 61 return files, 61 shared frames identical; spike equals spike_hist unit by unit in every file; per-frame cell counts are the spikes around each frame at no lag; the checkpoint flag rises in lattice G on all 63 trials; the learning point by the SI's rule over the five rats gives 26 +/- 9 trials, the paper's number; the tracked path fills the apparatus the SI describes; overview and animation frames looked at
